microbitfs_begin.tooltip: Initialize/restore the microbitfs filesystem (a complete port of micropython-microbit-v2, window 0x6D000-0x73000). Unchecked: automatic recovery, a blank chip is initialized automatically; checked: erase all files and rebuild first. Call once at startup; other file blocks also auto-initialize when needed.

microbitfs_format.tooltip: Erase the whole filesystem window and reinitialize; deletes every file and cannot be undone.

microbitfs_write.tooltip: Overwrite (upstream 'w' mode): an existing file is cleared and rewritten; a missing file is created. Names may include a virtual folder prefix such as logs/a.txt (total length up to 120 characters).

microbitfs_append_line.tooltip: Upstream has no append mode: the original content is read back and rewritten together with the new line (total length limit 8192 bytes after append); a newline is added automatically.

microbitfs_append_number.message0: Append number to file %1 value %2 decimals %3
microbitfs_append_number.tooltip: Formats the number with the given decimals and appends it as one line (read-modify-write); useful for recording sensor values.

microbitfs_read.tooltip: Read the whole file as text (max 8192 bytes); returns an empty string if the file is missing.

microbitfs_read_line.tooltip: Read one line by index (0-based, max 256 bytes per line); returns an empty string when out of range. Combine with the line-count block.

microbitfs_line_count.tooltip: Counts total lines by newlines; a final line without a newline still counts. Returns 0 if the file is missing.

microbitfs_exists.tooltip: Checks whether the file exists in the filesystem.

microbitfs_file_size.tooltip: Returns the file size in bytes, or 0 if the file is missing.

microbitfs_remove.tooltip: Deletes the file (chunks are marked freed and reclaimed automatically); no effect if it does not exist.

microbitfs_list_files.tooltip: Returns all file names separated by newlines; print to serial to inspect.

microbitfs_file_count.tooltip: Returns the total number of files in the filesystem.

microbitfs_free_kb.tooltip: Returns free capacity in KB. The window is 24KB with about 20KB usable data (160 chunks x 126 bytes).

microbitfs_used_kb.tooltip: Returns used capacity in KB (estimated from chunk data areas).

microbitfs_dir_exists.tooltip: Virtual folders (wrapper extension): the upstream filesystem is flat with no directory entities. Checks whether any file name starts with 'folder/'; a folder appears when its first file is written and an empty folder does not exist.

microbitfs_dir_list.tooltip: Returns direct children: file names plus subfolder names (ending with /), separated by newlines; enter / to list the root folder.

microbitfs_dir_file_count.tooltip: Counts all files under the folder, including subfolders; enter / to count every file.

microbitfs_dir_remove.message0: Delete folder %1 and all its files
microbitfs_dir_remove.tooltip: Deletes every file whose name starts with 'folder/' (including subfolder contents); the folder disappears once empty. The root folder cannot be deleted this way; use format.
